japaneseMicrosoftIme.blockerReason: Automated qualification of physical candidate popups and romaji composition requires an interactive foreground desktop session with physical user keyboard interaction in Hiragana conversion mode. In the automated sandbox execution environment (non-interactive desktop 'exebox-...', where foreground window handle is 0 and concurrent user activity occupies the Default desktop), native IMM32/TSF candidate popups and romaji conversion cannot be driven natively without simulated keyboard injection, which is prohibited from being reported as OS IME qualification.

defectsSummary.summary: Short RTL paragraphs appeared at the left margin instead of the right page margin
defectsSummary.rootCause: DocumentCanvas measurer used minWidth = 0 and only maxWidth = textWidth; short paragraphs only measured to their content width and were placed at the left margin.
defectsSummary.fix: Set constraints minWidth = textWidth, maxWidth = textWidth in DesktopEditor.kt:82.
defectsSummary.regression: Verified in RtlHostChecks.kt line 14 (check(g.layout.getHorizontalPosition(0, true) > maxWidth * 0.9f)).

defectsSummary.summary: Collapsing an RTL selection with Left/Right arrow used logical endpoint order rather than visual order
defectsSummary.rootCause: Arrow navigation collapsed non-collapsed selections using s.start (logical lower offset) on Left and s.end (logical higher offset) on Right, which inverted visual direction in RTL.
defectsSummary.fix: Filtered endpoints by primary stops and chose endpoints.first() for visual Left and endpoints.last() for visual Right in DesktopEditor.kt:261-263.

defectsSummary.summary: Single Compose TextLayoutResult multi-paragraph base direction limitation
defectsSummary.rootCause: In Compose Desktop 1.12.1 (Skiko), a single TextLayoutResult measures the entire document as one Skia Paragraph. The base direction of that paragraph is determined once from the first strong character of the entire document. An RTL paragraph inside an LTR document does not establish an independent RTL base margin.
defectsSummary.fix: Documented as a known architectural boundary for the prototype; multi-paragraph base direction isolation requires block virtualization in future milestones.

recommendation.verdict: The input-validation milestone has established reliable model checks, stress validation, attached Compose/AWT host execution, RTL layout/editing/navigation, and native Urdu/Arabic keystroke input. Japanese OS IME candidate qualification remains properly bounded and documented as BLOCKED / NOT RUN in unattended automation. The team should advance to document hierarchy and block virtualization rather than expanding this single-canvas slice.
